text_en: The Israelites set out, and camped in the plains of Moab across the Jordan from Jericho.
text_cn: 以色列子民再起程出发，在约但东边的摩阿布旷野中，对着耶里哥城扎了营。

text_en: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
text_cn: 漆颇尔的儿子巴拉克，见了以色列对阿摩黎人所做的一切；

text_en: Moab was in great dread of the people, because they were so numerous; Moab was overcome with fear of the people of Israel.
text_cn: 摩阿布人十分怕这民族，因为他们众多；摩阿布人对以色列子民大起恐慌，

text_en: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, “This horde will now lick up all that is around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field. ” Now Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
text_cn: 于是对米德杨的长老说：“现在这群人要吞并我们四周的一切，有如牛吃尽田间的青草。”漆颇尔的儿子巴拉克，其时正是摩阿布的君王，

text_en: He sent messengers to Balaam son of Beor at Pethor, which is on the Euphrates, in the land of Amaw, to summon him, saying, “A people has come out of Egypt; they have spread over the face of the earth, and they have settled next to me.
text_cn: 遂遣使者往幼发拉的河阿玛伍人之地的培托尔去， 见贝敖尔的儿子巴郎，请他说：“看，由埃及来了一个民族，遮盖了地面，现今正住在我的对面。

text_en: Come now, curse this people for me, since they are stronger than I; perhaps I shall be able to defeat them and drive them from the land; for I know that whomever you bless is blessed, and whomever you curse is cursed. ”
text_cn: 现在请你来，替我咒骂这民族，因为他们比我强大，或许这样我能将他们击败，从此地赶走；因为我知道，你祝福的，必蒙祝福；你咒骂的，必蒙咒骂。”

text_en: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the fees for divination in their hand; and they came to Balaam, and gave him Balak’s message.
text_cn: 摩阿布和米德杨的长老于是带着卜金去了；到了巴郎那里，将巴拉克的话告诉了他。

text_en: He said to them, “Stay here tonight, and I will bring back word to you, just as the Lord speaks to me”; so the officials of Moab stayed with Balaam.
text_cn: 他回答他们说：“今夜你们在这里过夜，我要依照上主吩咐我的话答复你们。”这样，摩阿布的缙绅就在巴郎那里住下了。

text_en: God came to Balaam and said, “Who are these men with you? ”
text_cn: 天主来到巴郎那里说：“与你在一起的是些什么人？”

text_en: Balaam said to God, “King Balak son of Zippor of Moab, has sent me this message:
text_cn: 巴郎答复天主说：“是摩阿布的君王，漆颇尔的儿子巴拉克，打发些人来告诉我说：

text_en: ‘A people has come out of Egypt and has spread over the face of the earth; now come, curse them for me; perhaps I shall be able to fight against them and drive them out. ’”
text_cn: 看从埃及来了一个民族，遮盖了地面，现在请你来替我咒骂他们，使我或许能与他们交战，将他们驱逐。”

text_en: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people, for they are blessed. ”
text_cn: 天主对巴郎说：“你不可与他们同去，你不可咒骂这民族，因为他们是受祝福的。”

text_en: So Balaam rose in the morning, and said to the officials of Balak, “Go to your own land, for the Lord has refused to let me go with you. ”
text_cn: 巴郎早晨起来就对巴拉克的缙绅说：“你们回本国去吧！因为上主不许我同你们一起去。”

text_en: So the officials of Moab rose and went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us. ”
text_cn: 摩阿布的缙绅就起身回到巴拉克那里说：“巴郎不愿同我们一起来。”

text_en: Once again Balak sent officials, more numerous and more distinguished than these.
text_cn: 巴拉克于是又派比以前更多更尊贵的缙绅去。

text_en: They came to Balaam and said to him, “Thus says Balak son of Zippor: ‘Do not let anything hinder you from coming to me;
text_cn: 他们去见巴郎，对他说：“漆颇尔的儿子巴拉克这样说：请你不要推辞到我这里来，

text_en: for I will surely do you great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do; come, curse this people for me. ’”
text_cn: 因为我必丰富地酬谢你。凡你要的，我都照办；只要你前来，替我咒骂这民族。”

text_en: But Balaam replied to the servants of Balak, “Although Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the command of the Lord my God, to do less or more.
text_cn: 巴郎答复巴拉克的使臣说：“即使巴拉克给我满屋的金银，我也不能做任何大小的事，违犯上主我天主的命令。

text_en: You remain here, as the others did, so that I may learn what more the Lord may say to me. ”
text_cn: 现在，请你们今夜也在这里住下，看看上主还要对我说什么。”

text_en: That night God came to Balaam and said to him, “If the men have come to summon you, get up and go with them; but do only what I tell you to do. ”
text_cn: 夜间天主来到巴郎那里，对他说：“这些人既然来邀请你，你就起身同他们去吧！但是你只应做我吩咐你的事。”

text_en: So Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the officials of Moab.
text_cn: 巴郎早晨起来，备好驴，就同摩阿布的缙绅一起去了。

text_en: God’s anger was kindled because he was going, and the angel of the Lord took his stand in the road as his adversary. Now he was riding on the donkey, and his two servants were with him.
text_cn: 因为他起身走了，天主发了怒；上主的使者在路上挡住他的去路。当时他骑着驴，还有两个童仆跟着。

text_en: The donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road, with a drawn sword in his hand; so the donkey turned off the road, and went into the field; and Balaam struck the donkey, to turn it back onto the road.
text_cn: 那驴一看见上主的使者，持着拔出的刀站在路上，就离开正路，走入田中去了。巴郎便打那驴，要它回到路上。

text_en: Then the angel of the Lord stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on either side.
text_cn: 以后，上主的使者又站在葡萄园间的窄路上，两面有墙。

text_en: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it scraped against the wall, and scraped Balaam’s foot against the wall; so he struck it again.
text_cn: 那驴一见上主的使者，就紧靠着墙，将巴郎的脚挤在墙上，他又打了那驴。

text_en: Then the angel of the Lord went ahead, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right or to the left.
text_cn: 上主的使者又往前行，站在窄狭的地方，左右无路可走，

text_en: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it lay down under Balaam; and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
text_cn: 那驴又见上主的使者，遂趴在巴郎下；巴郎大怒，用棍杖打那驴。

text_en: Then the Lord opened the mouth of the donkey, and it said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times? ”
text_cn: 上主遂开了驴的口，对巴郎说：“我对你作了什么？你竟三次打我？”

text_en: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have made a fool of me! I wish I had a sword in my hand! I would kill you right now! ”
text_cn: 巴郎回答那驴说：“因为你玩弄我。我若手中有刀，早杀了你。”

text_en: But the donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, which you have ridden all your life to this day? Have I been in the habit of treating you this way? ” And he said, “No. ”
text_cn: 那驴对巴郎说：“我不是你从起初直到今日所骑的驴吗？平常我是否对你这样做？”他回答说：“不”。

text_en: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road, with his drawn sword in his hand; and he bowed down, falling on his face.
text_cn: 上主遂开了巴郎的眼，使他看见上主的使者，手持拔出的刀站在路上，他就躬身俯伏在地。

text_en: The angel of the Lord said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.
text_cn: 上主的使者对他说：“你为什么三次打你的驴？看，是我出来挡路，因为你走的这路，在我面前是邪路。

text_en: The donkey saw me, and turned away from me these three times. If it had not turned away from me, surely just now I would have killed you and let it live. ”
text_cn: 驴看见了我，就在我面前回避了三次；幸亏它回避了我，不然我早杀了你，只留下了它。”

text_en: Then Balaam said to the angel of the Lord , “I have sinned, for I did not know that you were standing in the road to oppose me. Now therefore, if it is displeasing to you, I will return home. ”
text_cn: 巴郎于是对上主的使者说：“我犯了罪，因为我不知道是你站在路上拦阻我。现在，如果你以为不对，我就回去好了。”

text_en: The angel of the Lord said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but speak only what I tell you to speak. ” So Balaam went on with the officials of Balak.
text_cn: 上主的使者对巴郎说：“你同这些人去吧！但是你只应说我吩咐你的话。”巴郎于是同巴拉克的缙绅一起去了。

text_en: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him at Ir-moab, on the boundary formed by the Arnon, at the farthest point of the boundary.
text_cn: 巴拉克听说巴郎来了，就到阿尔摩阿布──此城临近阿尔农河边，在国界的尽头，──去迎接他。

text_en: Balak said to Balaam, “Did I not send to summon you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not able to honor you? ”
text_cn: 巴拉克对巴郎说：“我不是派遣了使者去请你？你为什么不到我这里来，莫非我不能酬报你？”

text_en: Balaam said to Balak, “I have come to you now, but do I have power to say just anything? The word God puts in my mouth, that is what I must say. ”
text_cn: 巴郎答复巴拉克说：“看，我已到你这里来了，但我能随便说什么吗？我只能说天主吩咐我说的话。”

text_en: Then Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
text_cn: 巴郎遂同巴拉克起身，来到了克黎雅特胡祚特。

text_en: Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent them to Balaam and to the officials who were with him.
text_cn: 巴拉克祭杀了牛羊，馈送给巴郎和同他在一起的缙绅。

text_en: On the next day Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal; and from there he could see part of the people of Israel.
text_cn: 到了次日早晨，巴拉克领巴郎上了巴摩特巴耳去，从那里能看到一部分以色列人民。
